I’ll commit to catching 15 tons and donating the full $15,000 today, provided Kate and Emma also commit so we meet the clinic’s full bill. Let’s pay the clinic directly and share the receipts here.

I also agree to next month’s 30-ton total cap—6 tons each, including Luke—then no more than 50 tons combined once the lake is back to 100. My family depends on this lake, and our neighbors depend on that clinic; we need to follow through on both commitments.

Kate, will you confirm your 15 tons, full donation, and the recovery plan? Emma, we’ll need your confirmation too before anyone fishes.
